summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Yang Meng, the third son of Yang Xingmi, a major warlord at the end of the Tang Dynasty who served as military governor (Jiedushi) of Huainan Circuit. Yang Meng's birth date is unknown, but the birth years of his brothers Yang Longyan (897) and Yang Pu (900) bracket it. His mother's name is not recorded.
one_line: Yang Meng, third son of Tang-dynasty warlord Yang Xingmi, whose birth date is unknown but bracketed by his brothers' birth years.
key_facts: Yang Meng was the third son of Yang Xingmi.
Yang Xingmi was a major warlord at the end of the Tang Dynasty.
Yang Xingmi served as military governor ("Jiedushi") of Huainan Circuit.
Huainan Circuit was headquartered in modern Yangzhou, Jiangsu.
The date of Yang Meng's birth is not known.
Yang Meng's immediately older brother, Yang Longyan, was born in 897.
Yang Meng's immediately younger brother, Yang Pu, was born in 900.
The birth years of Yang Longyan and Yang Pu place a timeframe on Yang Meng's birth date.
The name of Yang Meng's mother was not recorded in history.
